pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project root directory containing Java source files.
post_condition: If the CodeGraph backend is available, returns a dict mapping each caller FQN (str) to a set of callee FQNs (set[str]) for every call edge discovered in Java source files under proj_dir. Both caller and callee keys are canonicalized fully-qualified names using '::' as the separator with path-unsafe characters translated. Returns None if the CodeGraph backend cannot be initialized, signaling that the caller must use regex-based fallback extraction for Java call edges.
